name: Glob
description:
Tool to search for files matching a glob pattern

- Works fast with codebases of any size
- Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time
- Use this tool when you need to find files by name patterns
- You have the capability to call multiple tools in a single response. It is always better to speculatively perform multiple searches that are potentially useful as a batch.

glob_pattern.description:
The glob pattern to match files against.
Patterns not starting with "**/" are automatically prepended with "**/" to enable recursive searching.

Examples:
	- "*.js" (becomes "**/*.js") - find all .js files
	- "**/node_modules/**" - find all node_modules directories
	- "**/test/**/test_*.ts" - find all test_*.ts files in any test directory

target_directory.description: Absolute path to directory to search for files in. If not provided, defaults to Cursor workspace root.

name: Grep
description: A search tool built on ripgrep. Results are capped to several thousand output lines for responsiveness; when truncation occurs, the results report "at least" counts, but are otherwise accurate.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-C.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-i.description: Case insensitive search (rg -i) Defaults to false

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

head_limit.description: Limit output size. For "content" mode: limits total matches shown. For "files_with_matches" and "count" modes: limits number of files.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

offset.description: Skip first N entries. For "content" mode: skips first N matches. For "files_with_matches" and "count" modes: skips first N files. Use with head_limit for pagination.

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "content".

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg pattern -- PATH). Defaults to Cursor workspace root.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

name: Read
description: Reads a file from the local filesystem. This tool can also read image files when called with the appropriate path. Formats supported: jpeg/jpg, png, gif, webp.

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Positive values are 1-indexed from the start of the file. Negative values count backwards from the end (e.g. -1 is the last line). Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

path.description: The absolute path of the file to read.

name: Delete
description:
Deletes a file at the specified path. The operation will fail gracefully if:
    - The file doesn't exist
    - The operation is rejected for security reasons
    - The file cannot be deleted

path.description: The absolute path of the file to delete

name: StrReplace
description: Performs exact string replacements in files.

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

name: Write
description: Writes a file to the local filesystem.

contents.description: The contents to write to the file

path.description: The absolute path to the file to modify

name: Shell
description: Executes a given command in a shell session with optional foreground timeout. Use this for terminal operations. Do not use it for reading, writing, editing, or searching files. block_until_ms is how long to wait before moving the command to the background; it defaults to 30000. Set it to 0 to run in the background immediately. required_permissions may be "full_network" or "all".

block_until_ms.description: How long to block and wait for the command to complete before moving it to the background, in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000. Set to 0 to run in the background immediately.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in 5-10 words

working_directory.description: The absolute path to the working directory to execute the command in

required_permissions.description: Optional permissions. Use "full_network" for unrestricted network access, or "all" to disable the sandbox.

name: ReadLints
description: Read linter diagnostics for files or directories. paths is optional; when omitted, Cursor checks the workspace.

name: TodoWrite
description: Update the todo list for this conversation. todos is an array of {id, content, status}. status is pending, in_progress, completed, or cancelled. merge merges into the existing list when true.

name: EditNotebook
description: Edit one cell of a Jupyter notebook. old_string must be unique inside the cell. Set is_new_cell to insert a cell at cell_idx.

name: AskQuestion
description: Ask the user one or more questions and wait for the selected options.

name: SwitchMode
description: Ask to switch the current conversation to agent, ask, plan, debug, or multitask, then continue the same conversation.

name: CreatePlan
description: Present a plan for the user to accept.

name: UpdateCurrentStep
description: Update the current step shown to the user.

name: WebSearch
description: Search the web after the user approves.

name: WebFetch
description: Fetch a URL after the user approves and return the page text.

name: GetMcpTools
description: List MCP tools available in this conversation.

name: CallMcpTool
description: Call an MCP tool by server and toolName.

name: FetchMcpResource
description: Read an MCP resource.

name: Task
description: Start a subagent. The parent conversation continues when it returns.

name: GenerateImage
description: Generate an image with the endpoint configured on the settings page. Omitted when that endpoint is empty.

name: SemSearch
description: Search the workspace for code related to a question. Use this to find where something is implemented or how a behavior works. Prefer it when the query is a question. Use Grep when every exact occurrence of a string is required.
